description: This file defines a function 'formatGeneratedModule' that formats generated code using an external formatter (oxfmt) or a fallback command, based on platform and availability. It handles temporary file creation, calling external processes, and error handling.

methods.name: formatGeneratedModule
methods.description: Formats source code string 'source' by writing it to a temporary file and then invoking an external formatter ('oxfmt') or 'pnpm' command depending on platform and availability. Returns the formatted code as a string.
